title:
Needs repair: the new rise claim loses two essential conditions.
Next: Claude

items.current_text: or if finding rose with a doubling time of [1.5]{.C57}–[5.1]{.C57} Myr or less, fitting any older ancestor
items.problem: The absence of an older limit requires an exponential rise, and the maximum doubling time depends on the assumed independent-find count. Omitting both conditions generalises the result beyond C57 and leaves the numerical range ambiguous.
items.evidence: C57 specifies exponential histories. Results (f), lines 266–271, restricts the unlimited-age result to that family and distinguishes counts. Supplement S5.9, lines 885–899, derives count-specific limiting doubling times: approximately 1.48 Myr for 48 independent finds and 5.09 Myr for 15.
items.repair: Replace with: “or if finding rose exponentially, doubling within [1.5]{.C57}–[5.1]{.C57} Myr depending on the count, allowing any older ancestor”. The abstract remains 200 words.
